name: @estates/cardnft
description: ESTATES concealed cards as FULL 1-sat BSV NFTs: each card is a UTXO (outpoint + 1-sat <commitment> OP_DROP P2PKH output). A transfer SPENDS Alice's outpoint and creates Bob's successor 1-sat NFT, so Alice's card is on-chain DEAD (no copy). Bridges @estates/deck (concealment) + @estates/onchain (UTXO).
